_provenance: Card definitions live in card-catalogue.json and NOWHERE else. This file names which of those products are researched acquisition candidates; it does not redefine them. Before 2026-08-24 it carried full duplicate definitions, and they had already drifted from the same cards elsewhere — identical rates under different ruleIds (bmo-cashback-we-gas-3pct vs bmo-cb-we-gas-ev-3pct), plus two ids for Simplii. A card defined in two places always drifts; a card referenced by id cannot.
